rpc_flake_root_cause: In internal/adapters/rpc/roundrobin.go, rankEndpointsDetailed() returned endpoints in non-deterministic order when ALL endpoints failed (the channel-driven collection completed in goroutine scheduling order, not in input index order). The test TestRoundRobinProvider_Endpoint fed test.example.com endpoints that all fail DNS; the order returned by NewRoundRobinProvider depended on which goroutine finished first, causing the test to be flaky.
rpc_flake_fix: Modified rankEndpointsDetailed's allFailed branch to call sort.SliceStable(probeResults, by index) so the result preserves the caller's input order. Single-line addition: sort by index before returning. No real assertions removed; no test scope expanded to real network.
test_race_entry_point: make test-race covers ./internal/adapters/store/postgres and ./internal/adapters/rpc. Full-repo race coverage intentionally deferred (kept iteration time low; will be expanded in a future stage when the focused packages are clean).
